snippet.title: BRINKO - Party Royale | Trailer
snippet.description:
Race, fall, respawn, and fight your way back in a fast online party royale.

Now testing in India. 
Available only for Android Currently.
Brinko is in very early Alpha stage, so there are some obvious bugs & features missing, which will be ironed out as we progress so please bear with us ❤️


- There's no schedule about when new regions are added or when more platforms will be supported.

⬇️Download Here⬇️
🤖 https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kitkagames.partyroyale&pcampaignid=web_share

Brinko is a real-time multiplayer obstacle racing game where up to 32 players dash through chaotic courses, dodge wild hazards, wipe out in hilarious ways, and bounce back for another shot at victory.
Easy to play. Funny to fail. Skillful to master.

🏃32-PLAYER REAL-TIME ONLINE RACES
Jump into fast online races with up to 32 players in real time. Sprint with the crowd, dodge moving obstacles, avoid messy pileups, and race your way to the finish before the chaos catches you.

💯FALL FAST. RESPAWN FASTER.
In Brinko, falling does not mean the fun is over. Wipe out, respawn quickly, rejoin the race, and keep moving. A bad jump can still turn into your next comeback.

💥CHAOTIC OBSTACLE COURSES
Run through colorful levels packed with swinging hazards, spinning obstacles, moving platforms, tricky jumps, and unpredictable physics. Every race is quick, messy, and full of surprise moments.

🤣FUNNY PHYSICS, REAL SKILL
Brinko uses playful physics to create hilarious stumbles, close calls, and unexpected recoveries. The controls are simple, but smart movement matters. Time your jumps, read the course, dodge the crowd, and find the best path through the chaos.

⚡QUICK MATCHES, INSTANT REMATCHES
Brinko is built for short, action-packed sessions. Jump in for a quick race, wipe out, recover, finish, and play again. Every match gives you another chance to improve, win, or pull off a ridiculous comeback.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Party up with friends and race together in chaotic online matches. Compete for the finish, laugh at the wipeouts, and see who can survive the madness.

🔎COLLECT EXTRA REWARDS WHILE YOU RACE
Keep your eyes on the course — extra collectibles can appear during matches. Grab them as you race to boost your progress and earn more rewards over time.

🎽CUSTOMIZE YOUR BRINKO STYLE
Keep progressing to unlock new skins and customize your character. Claim your favorites, switch your look, and stand out in every race.

📦🚫NO GACHA. NO LOOTBOXES.
Brinko does not use gacha or mystery rewards. Purchases are clear and direct, so you always know exactly what you are getting before you buy.

🚫NO PAY-TO-WIN.
Brinko is built to stay fair. Purchases will not decide who wins the race. Skill, timing, recovery, and a little bit of chaos matter more than anything you can buy.

🏗️BUILT TO KEEP GROWING
Brinko is made for more maps, events, mini games, customization, social features, gameplay updates, and fresh ways to play over time.

WHY PLAY BRINKO?
• Fast online party royale racing
• Up to 32 players in real-time races
• Chaotic obstacle courses
• Funny physics and wild wipeouts
• Quick respawns after falls
• Short matches and instant rematches
• Simple, responsive touch controls
• Skill-based jumping, dodging, and recovery
• Party up and play with friends
• Collect extra rewards during races
• Unlock skins and customize your character
• No gacha or mystery purchases
• No pay-to-win

Brinko is for players who want a casual online party royale that is fast, funny, competitive, and easy to replay.
Winning feels great.
Falling is part of the fun.

Play Brinko and bounce back faster than everyone else.
